CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_task_with_details(p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS tasks
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  caller uuid := auth.uid();
  caller_profile public.profiles;
  target_org uuid;
  selected_assignee uuid := nullif(p_payload ->> 'assigned_to', '')::uuid;
  initial_status text;
  task_priority text := coalesce(nullif(trim(p_payload ->> 'priority'), ''), 'medium');
  created_task public.tasks;
begin
  if caller is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication is required to create a task'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  select * into caller_profile
  from public.profiles
  where id = caller and is_active;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'An active eFlow profile is required to create a task'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if nullif(trim(p_payload ->> 'title'), '') is null then
    raise exception 'Task title is required'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if task_priority not in ('low', 'medium', 'high') then
    raise exception 'Invalid task priority'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  target_org := coalesce(
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'org_id', '')::uuid,
    caller_profile.org_id
  );
  if not public.can_create_scoped_work(target_org, caller) then
    raise exception 'You cannot create tasks in this organization'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if selected_assignee is not null and not exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles
    where id = selected_assignee and is_active
  ) then
    raise exception 'Task assignee must be an active eFlow user'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  initial_status := case
    when selected_assignee is null then 'pending_assignment'
    else 'todo'
  end;

  insert into public.tasks (
    title,
    description,
    status,
    priority,
    assigned_to,
    assignee_name,
    department,
    org_id,
    team_id,
    team_name,
    team_member_ids,
    team_member_names,
    deadline,
    due_date,
    tags,
    recommended_employee_ids,
    recommendation_reasoning,
    recommendation_source,
    recommendation_lead_id,
    reviewer_id,
    backup_reviewer_id,
    acceptance_criteria,
    definition_of_done,
    dependency_ids,
    burnout_warning,
    proposal_id,
    proposal_title,
    program_id,
    program_title,
    project_id,
    project_title,
    activity_id,
    activity_title,
    activity_schedule,
    hierarchy_path,
    import_batch_id,
    barangay,
    estimated_hours,
    budget_impact,
    linked_project_id,
    milestone_id,
    percent_complete,
    created_by
  ) values (
    trim(p_payload ->> 'title'),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'description', ''),
    initial_status,
    task_priority,
    selected_assignee,
    coalesce(p_payload ->> 'assignee_name', ''),
    coalesce(p_payload ->> 'department', ''),
    target_org,
    coalesce(p_payload ->> 'team_id', ''),
    coalesce(p_payload ->> 'team_name', ''),
    array(
      select value::uuid
      from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(p_payload -> 'team_member_ids', '[]'::jsonb))
    ),
    array(
      select value
      from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(p_payload -> 'team_member_names', '[]'::jsonb))
    ),
    coalesce(p_payload ->> 'deadline', ''),
    coalesce(p_payload ->> 'due_date', p_payload ->> 'deadline', ''),
    array(
      select value
      from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(p_payload -> 'tags', '[]'::jsonb))
    ),
    array(
      select value::uuid
      from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(p_payload -> 'recommended_employee_ids', '[]'::jsonb))
    ),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'recommendation_reasoning', ''),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'recommendation_source', ''),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'recommendation_lead_id', '')::uuid,
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'reviewer_id', '')::uuid,
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'backup_reviewer_id', '')::uuid,
    coalesce(p_payload -> 'acceptance_criteria', '[]'::jsonb),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'definition_of_done', ''),
    coalesce(
      array(
        select value::uuid
        from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(p_payload -> 'dependency_ids', '[]'::jsonb))
      ),
      '{}'::uuid[]
    ),
    coalesce((p_payload ->> 'burnout_warning')::boolean, false),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'proposal_id', ''),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'proposal_title', ''),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'program_id', ''),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'program_title', ''),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'project_id', ''),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'project_title', ''),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'activity_id', ''),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'activity_title', ''),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'activity_schedule', ''),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'hierarchy_path', ''),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'import_batch_id', ''),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'barangay', ''),
    coalesce((p_payload ->> 'estimated_hours')::numeric, 0),
    coalesce((p_payload ->> 'budget_impact')::numeric, 0),
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'linked_project_id', '')::uuid,
    nullif(p_payload ->> 'milestone_id', '')::uuid,
    coalesce((p_payload ->> 'percent_complete')::int, 0),
    caller
  )
  returning * into created_task;

  return created_task;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_m7.with_schedule(p_snapshot jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_set(jsonb_set(p_snapshot,'{root,scheduling}',jsonb_build_object(
  'version',1,'today',eflow_m7.work_day((p_snapshot->'root'->>'id')::uuid))),
  '{nodes}',coalesce((
   select jsonb_agg(n.value || jsonb_build_object('start_date',s.start_date,'started_at',s.started_at,
    'effective_status',case when s.started_at is not null and n.value->>'status'='todo'
      then 'in_progress' else n.value->>'status' end) order by n.ordinality)
   from jsonb_array_elements(p_snapshot->'nodes') with ordinality n(value,ordinality)
   left join lateral (
    select start_date,started_at from public.subtasks where id=(n.value->>'id')::uuid and p_snapshot->'root'->>'kind'='office'
    union all
    select start_date,started_at from public.personal_subtasks where id=(n.value->>'id')::uuid and p_snapshot->'root'->>'kind'='personal'
   ) s on true
   where case when p_snapshot->'root'->>'kind'='office' then eflow_m7.node_visible(
     (p_snapshot->'root'->>'id')::uuid,(n.value->>'id')::uuid,auth.uid())
   else eflow_m7.personal_node_visible((p_snapshot->'root'->>'id')::uuid,(n.value->>'id')::uuid) end
  ),'[]'::jsonb));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_phase65.baseline_fingerprint(p_id uuid, p_kind text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select md5(jsonb_build_object(
 'project',case p_kind when 'structure' then jsonb_build_array(p.description,p.org_id)
  when 'dates' then jsonb_build_array(p.start_date,p.target_date) else '[]'::jsonb end,
 'tasks',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(case p_kind
  when 'structure' then jsonb_build_array(t.id,t.description,t.org_id,t.acceptance_criteria,t.definition_of_done)
  when 'dates' then jsonb_build_array(t.id,t.start_date,t.deadline,t.dependency_ids)
  else jsonb_build_array(t.id,t.budget_impact) end order by t.id),'[]'::jsonb)
  from public.tasks t where t.linked_project_id=p.id and t.deleted_at is null and t.status<>'cancelled'),
 'offices',case when p_kind='structure' then (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(o.office_id,o.relationship_type,o.invitation_status) order by o.office_id),'[]'::jsonb) from public.project_offices o where o.project_id=p.id and o.invitation_status<>'revoked') else '[]'::jsonb end
 )::text) from public.projects p where p.id=p_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_seal.dossier(p_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb; ids text; requests text; allocations text; liquidations text; journal_ids text; entities text;
begin
 ids:=format('select id from public.tasks where linked_project_id=%L::uuid',p_id);
 requests:='select id from public.petty_cash_requests where task_id in ('||ids||')';
 allocations:='select id from public.work_budget_allocations where task_id in ('||ids||')';
 liquidations:='select id from public.petty_cash_liquidations where request_id in ('||requests||')';
 journal_ids:='select id from public.general_journal_entries where source_id::text in (select id::text from public.petty_cash_requests where task_id in ('||ids||') union select id::text from public.petty_cash_liquidations where request_id in ('||requests||') union select id::text from public.petty_cash_releases where request_id in ('||requests||'))';
 journal_ids:='with recursive related(id) as (('||journal_ids||') union select j.id from public.general_journal_entries j join related r on j.source_id=r.id) select id from related';
 entities:=format('select %L::text as id union select id::text from public.tasks where linked_project_id=%L::uuid union select id::text from public.subtasks where task_id in (%s) union select id::text from public.petty_cash_requests where id in (%s) union select id::text from public.petty_cash_liquidations where id in (%s) union select id::text from public.petty_cash_releases where request_id in (%s) union select id::text from public.work_budget_allocations where id in (%s) union select id::text from public.milestones where project_id=%L::uuid',p_id::text,p_id,ids,requests,liquidations,requests,allocations,p_id);
 select jsonb_build_object('schema_version',1,'project',to_jsonb(p)-array['archive_reminded_at','archive_blocked_at'],
  'office',jsonb_build_object('id',o.id,'name',o.name)) into result from public.projects p join public.organizations o on o.id=p.org_id where p.id=p_id;
 if result is null then raise exception 'Project not found.' using errcode='22023'; end if;
 return eflow_seal.public_fields(result||jsonb_build_object(
  'groups',eflow_seal.rows(format('select * from public.project_groups where project_id=%L::uuid',p_id)),
  'members',eflow_seal.rows(format('select m.user_id,m.role,u.full_name from public.project_members m left join public.profiles u on u.id=m.user_id where m.project_id=%L::uuid',p_id)),
  'project_guests',eflow_seal.rows(format('select m.user_id,m.office_id,m.engagement,m.access_end,m.until_close,m.ended_at,u.full_name from public.project_guest_members m left join public.profiles u on u.id=m.user_id where m.project_id=%L::uuid',p_id)),
  'offices',eflow_seal.rows(format('select * from public.project_offices where project_id=%L::uuid',p_id)),
  'participating_offices',eflow_seal.rows(format('select * from public.project_organizations where project_id=%L::uuid',p_id)),
  'office_work',eflow_seal.rows(format('select * from public.project_office_work where project_id=%L::uuid',p_id)),
  'office_people',eflow_seal.rows(format('select * from public.project_office_people where project_id=%L::uuid',p_id)),
  'office_identities',eflow_seal.rows(format('select id,display_name,canonical_office_id,relationship_type,contact_status from public.project_office_identities where project_id=%L::uuid',p_id)),
  'office_members',eflow_seal.rows(format('select m.*,u.full_name from public.project_office_members m join public.project_offices o on o.id=m.project_office_id left join public.profiles u on u.id=m.user_id where o.project_id=%L::uuid',p_id)),
  'milestones',eflow_seal.rows(format('select * from public.milestones where project_id=%L::uuid',p_id)),
  'milestone_offices',eflow_seal.rows(format('select o.* from public.milestone_organizations o join public.milestones m on m.id=o.milestone_id where m.project_id=%L::uuid',p_id)),
  'tasks',eflow_seal.rows('select id,title,description,status,priority,assigned_to,assignee_name,team_member_ids,team_member_names,deadline,due_date,start_date,dependency_ids,group_id,workspace_position,reviewer_id,backup_reviewer_id,acceptance_criteria,definition_of_done,cancellation_reason,cancelled_at,created_at,updated_at,deleted_at from public.tasks where id in ('||ids||')'),
  'subtasks',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.subtasks where task_id in ('||ids||')'),
  'task_submissions',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.task_submissions where task_id in ('||ids||')'),
  'subtask_submissions',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.subtask_submissions where task_id in ('||ids||')'),
  'task_updates',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.task_progress_updates where task_id in ('||ids||')'),
  'subtask_updates',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.subtask_progress_updates where task_id in ('||ids||')'),
  'status_history',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.task_status_history where task_id in ('||ids||')'),
  'comments',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.task_comments where task_id in ('||ids||')'),
  'comment_files',eflow_seal.rows('select a.* from public.task_comment_attachments a join public.task_comments c on c.id=a.comment_id where c.task_id in ('||ids||')'),
  'task_files',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.task_attachments where task_id in ('||ids||')'),
  'subtask_files',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.subtask_submission_attachments where task_id in ('||ids||')'),
  'library_files',eflow_seal.rows(format('select * from public.project_library_files where project_id=%L::uuid and state=''ready''',p_id)),
  'library_links',eflow_seal.rows(format('select l.* from public.project_library_links l join public.project_library_files f on f.id=l.file_id where f.project_id=%L::uuid and f.state=''ready''',p_id)),
  'funding',eflow_seal.rows(format('select f.*,s.name as account_name from eflow_project.funding f left join public.office_budget_sections s on s.id=f.partition_id where f.project_id=%L::uuid',p_id)),
  'allocations',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.work_budget_allocations where id in ('||allocations||')'),
  'allocation_lines',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.work_budget_allocation_lines where allocation_id in ('||allocations||')'),
  'cash_requests',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.petty_cash_requests where id in ('||requests||')'),
  'cash_releases',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.petty_cash_releases where request_id in ('||requests||')'),
  'liquidations',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.petty_cash_liquidations where id in ('||liquidations||')'),
  'receipts',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.petty_cash_receipts where liquidation_id in ('||liquidations||')'),
  'receipt_items',eflow_seal.rows('select i.* from public.petty_cash_receipt_items i join public.petty_cash_receipts r on r.id=i.receipt_id where r.liquidation_id in ('||liquidations||')'),
  'request_files',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.petty_cash_request_attachments where request_id in ('||requests||')'),
  'budget_ledger',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.budget_ledger_entries where task_id in ('||ids||') or petty_cash_request_id in ('||requests||')'),
  'journal_entries',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.general_journal_entries where id in ('||journal_ids||')'),
  'journal_lines',eflow_seal.rows('select * from public.general_journal_lines where journal_entry_id in ('||journal_ids||')'),
  'audit',eflow_seal.rows('select id,actor_name,entity_type,entity_id,action,reason,before_data,after_data,created_at from public.audit_events where entity_id in ('||entities||')')
 ));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_work_edit.record_task_details()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare a jsonb:=to_jsonb(old);b jsonb:=to_jsonb(new);fields jsonb;reason text;
begin
 if a ? 'dependency_ids' then a:=jsonb_set(a,'{dependency_ids}',eflow_work_edit.dependency_value(a->'dependency_ids'));end if;
 if b ? 'dependency_ids' then b:=jsonb_set(b,'{dependency_ids}',eflow_work_edit.dependency_value(b->'dependency_ids'));end if;
 -- Canonical worker arrays may retain the Lead for compatibility; Activity shows contributors only.
 if jsonb_typeof(a->'team_member_ids')='array' then
  a:=jsonb_set(a,'{team_member_ids}',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(v order by v) from jsonb_array_elements(a->'team_member_ids') x(v) where v is distinct from a->'assigned_to'),'[]'::jsonb));end if;
 if jsonb_typeof(b->'team_member_ids')='array' then
  b:=jsonb_set(b,'{team_member_ids}',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(v order by v) from jsonb_array_elements(b->'team_member_ids') x(v) where v is distinct from b->'assigned_to'),'[]'::jsonb));end if;
 select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key',f.key,'label',f.label,
  'before',eflow_work_edit.display(f.key,a->f.key),'after',eflow_work_edit.display(f.key,b->f.key)) order by f.position)
 into fields from (values ('title','Title',1),('description','Description',2),('priority','Priority',3),
  ('start_date','Start date',4),('deadline','Due date',5),('dependency_ids','Prerequisites',6),
  ('estimated_hours','Estimated hours',7),('budget_impact','Budget estimate',8),('group_id','Group',9),
  ('workspace_position','Position',10),('assigned_to','Lead',11),('team_member_ids','Contributors',12),
  ('reviewer_id','Reviewer',13),('acceptance_criteria','Acceptance criteria',14),
  ('definition_of_done','Definition of done',15),('due_date','Due date (stored compatibility value)',16)) f(key,label,position)
 where a->f.key is distinct from b->f.key
  and (f.key<>'due_date' or a->'deadline' is not distinct from b->'deadline'
    or a->'deadline' is distinct from a->'due_date' or b->'deadline' is distinct from b->'due_date')
  and not (f.key in ('assigned_to','team_member_ids') and coalesce(eflow_r7.internal(new.id),false));
 if fields is null then return new;end if;
 if a->'deadline' is distinct from b->'deadline' or a->'due_date' is distinct from b->'due_date' then
  reason:=nullif(btrim(current_setting('eflow.work_detail_change_reason',true)),'');end if;
 insert into public.task_activities(task_id,actor_id,actor_name,type,content,metadata)
 values(new.id,auth.uid(),coalesce((select full_name from public.profiles where id=auth.uid()),'System'),
  'work_details_edited',(select string_agg(x->>'label'||': '||(x->>'before')||' → '||(x->>'after'),E'\n') from jsonb_array_elements(fields) x),
  jsonb_build_object('version',1,'fields',fields,'reason',reason));
 return new;
end $function$
